answer: Identity bonds decaying like shale layers stop bulk fakes. Each agent posts one bond worth twice 30 days' expected earnings before entering the reward pool through its single inlet. It decays 5% per epoch, so each epoch costs a renewal fee paid from real work. An attacker running 100 fakes must fund 100 decaying bonds, about 200 times an honest agent's cost, while the shared nectar stays thin. Honest agents pay once and keep their share.
